column1: # Live run: NA12878, PacBio Onso (PE100), Twist Exome 2.x capture.
# Scored against the Twist Exome 2.0.2 capture BED (config intervals.bed = twist).
# FULL 8-PLEX POOL: all 8 libraries are the SAME sample (NA12878), so they are
# 8 sequencing units of one sample -> pooled to raise depth and lift the
# low-coverage capture targets (the dominant recall limiter at 1 replicate).
# PL:ILLUMINA — Onso emits Illumina-compatible short reads; the PL tag is cosmetic
# for this short-read pipeline (bwa-mem / GATK do not branch on it here).
